claim_scope: Research-only structural evidence for part of GlobalSettlementABI V1. Lean proves closed abstract lane/effect/reject enumerations, per-asset issue and burn projections, accepted evidence by construction, abstract rejection reduction, and ordered-plan laws. ESSO with Z3 and CVC5 proves initialization and one-step inductiveness of one finite invariant conjunction over a two-asset bounded model. Executable differential tests bind selected enum, sign, projection, application, reject-projection, and mutation observations to the pinned Python surface.

an accepted abstract outcome can be constructed without well-formedness, application, and non-negativity evidence
a rejected bounded step mutates an authoritative accounting or replay field or emits an economic row

aaa.reason: Focused scenario and negative tests arrange an explicit book, command, proof file, or evidence payload; act through one transition, compiler, scanner, or admission function; and assert exact effects, rejection labels, projection state, or fail-closed error. Property, differential, stateful, and formal nodes keep their native invariant-oriented shape.

reject_is_noop.reason: For the finite ESSO model, every named rejection preserves exactly the sixteen-field AUTHORITATIVE_PROJECTION and emits zero economic rows. Evidence-journal fields may change. The Lean theorem proves only reduction to the same abstract AssetBook and identity abstract plan. No full runtime state-root or history no-op is claimed.

nonclaims: This packet establishes no production, settlement, release, migration, proof-receipt, or value-moving authority.

The Lean model is an abstraction of part of GlobalEconomicEffectPlanV1. It does not prove canonical rows, roots, lane writes, occurrence consumption, external outbox behavior, terminal-obligation lifecycle, integer bounds, or Python/Rust/RISC0 refinement.

The local placeholder scanner blocks declarations in the two proof files. A separate Lean print-axioms gate allows only propext, Quot.sound, and Classical.choice for the explicit 34-claim surface; other theorem declarations are outside that gate, and trust in Lean, Mathlib, and their toolchain remains external.

The ESSO result proves initialization and one-step inductiveness of the invariant conjunction for its finite two-asset model. It does not prove each invariant independently or establish runtime refinement.

The bounded model leaves command-lane compatibility, unknown-asset policy, authorization derivation, terminal-obligation identities, canonical hashes, production widths, fee-residue mapping, and runtime refinement open.
The current Python refinement rejects nonzero carried fee residue because no state-bearing mapping exists. The ESSO residue location is a documented candidate, not an implemented runtime rule.

The closed-schema ESSO parser validates declared payload fields and exact recorded tool configuration. Its deterministic fixture is not historical provenance, and neither fixture acceptance nor live process output is a cryptographic replay receipt.
The aggregate Proofs.lean target has a pre-existing missing Proofs.DeltaAccounting import outside this change; only the two new proof targets are admitted here.
Passing these tests and formal checks does not guarantee all ZenoDEX value movement.
